originalEntry.title: Doodle history of humanity ending with Opus 5.5
originalEntry.author: songkeys
originalEntry.description: A 108-second origami and doodle animation of civilization from its start to the hatching of AI and Opus 5.5, with almost no text, built in pure JavaScript.
originalEntry.description_zh: 108 秒折纸涂鸦动画，从人类诞生讲到孵出 AI 和 Opus 5.5，几乎无字，纯 JavaScript 实现。
originalEntry.prompt: Create a short origami / doodle-style animation showing humanity’s development, progress, and civilization from birth to the present, and ultimately the hatching of AI. AI then gradually develops and advances, eventually hatching today’s Opus 5.5 (you). Style: doodly, cute, warm, strongly narrative, no spoken language (simple text is OK, but don’t use too much explanatory/narrative text, because I want different civilizations to be able to understand it), poetic, moving, high quality.
originalEntry.prompt_zh: 制作一段折纸 / 涂鸦风格的短动画，展现人类从诞生到现在的发展、进步与文明，最终孵化出 AI。随后 AI 逐步发展、进化，最终孵化出今天的 Opus 5.5（也就是你）。风格：涂鸦感、可爱、温暖、叙事性强，不用口语对白（可以有简单文字，但别用太多解释性或叙述性的文字，因为我希望不同的文明都能看懂），有诗意、动人、高质量。
originalEntry.note: Author: 2 prompts (the second was notes on draft scenes), 3 hours, max effort, about 130M tokens (about $60 at API prices).
originalEntry.note_zh: 作者称用了 2 轮提示（第二轮是对分镜草稿的修改意见）、3 小时，max effort，约 1.3 亿 token（按 API 价约 60 美元）。
